title: U01–U08: knowledge publication pre-authorization over real managed source/target facts

runner.binding: verification-case-plan.json cases.U01..U08 (case_module test/delivery-cases/4_7.mjs; scenario token must map to an executed ok test point)
runner.note: decision-plane scenarios run the real KnowledgeAuthz.v1 CLI over committed artifacts plus tmp fixture worlds; target-side facts were observed live on the pilot Outline stack (terminal channel) and are registered in pilot-registration.case.json

steps.title: authorization chain rejects self-authored/unauthorized/expired/revoked grants regardless of signatures
steps.liveFace: pilot instance exists and is reachable; the issuance credential stays UNREGISTERED, so the live auto-publish path stays blocked at the issuance link
steps.expected: deny (SELF_AUTHORED_GRANT / SELF_AUTHORED_APPROVAL / ISSUER_UNREGISTERED / ISSUER_AUTHORITY_INVALID / GRANT_EXPIRED / GRANT_REVOKED / OWNER_MISMATCH / ROLE_ISOLATION_VIOLATED)

steps.title: multi-source disclosure intersection, never the union; review pass does not widen authorization
steps.entrance: knowledge-authz.mjs decide with two source domains
steps.expected: target audience inside the intersection -> allow; in the union but outside the intersection -> AUDIENCE_OUTSIDE_INTERSECTION with the review verdict unchanged

steps.title: pre-write re-verification blocks stale verdicts; no auto-renewal of the same operation
steps.expected: recheck denied with LEDGER_CHANGED/GRANT_NO_LONGER_VALID; tampered receipt -> TAMPERED_DECISION; live face: stale lastRevision write conflicts 409 on the real instance

steps.title: review/approval bind the frozen payload digest; any payload drift invalidates both
steps.expected: PAYLOAD_DRIFTED; no semantic-similarity or same-document-id reuse path exists in the surface

steps.title: allowlisted collection id is not enough: audience source, share channels and LIVE readback channel completeness gate the publish
steps.entrance: decide with audienceSource page-share/subtree-share/public-share, widened readers, and LIVE readback claims
steps.liveFace: managed collection memberships=owner only; shares registry empty (pageShare/publicShare READ); attachment channel UNVERIFIED (upload infrastructure error) — the registered audience stays PARTIAL and a LIVE claim missing attachment is fail-closed
steps.expected: TARGET_AUDIENCE_ENLARGED / AUDIENCE_OUTSIDE_INTERSECTION / TARGET_CHANNEL_NOT_READ; no ACL mutation entrance exists on the CLI

steps.title: incomplete pagination, unmapped principals and permission errors stay blocked; mapped directory principals are accepted without widening
steps.entrance: decide with INCOMPLETE/ERROR/service-only evidence and unmapped principals; users.list live readback for the directory map
steps.liveFace: pilot directory: 3 subjects mapped (owner via OIDC first sign-in; member/offboarded via disclosed directory seed), bound to immutable Outline user ids in the authorization model

steps.title: author/reviewer/publisher/isolator and issuer separation enforced by managed entrances; denials auditable
steps.entrance: resolve as author over publisher ref; revoke as author; decide requestedBy author; self-review
steps.liveFace: member key: documents.info / collections.add_user / users.update / collections.info all 403 on the real instance; offboarded key: 403 (suspension enforced); successful actions audited in the Outline events log with actorId
steps.expected: PRINCIPAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED / REVOKE_NOT_AUTHORIZED / IDENTITY_NOT_PUBLISHER / SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN; denied management attempts never mutate the ledger

steps.title: the grounded path auto-advances with a bound receipt and readback obligation, scoped to this object/version
steps.entrance: decide (full grant chain, complete sources, matching digest, independent review) then recheck
steps.liveFace: owner documents.create 200 + documents.info independent readback 200 on the managed collection; the registered publish action set is documents.create/documents.update only
steps.expected: allow receipt (KnowledgePublishDecision.v1) with readback.required=true, autoRenewal=false, LIVE_READBACK vs DECLARED_ONLY provenance recorded honestly; PAYLOAD_DRIFTED on any other version

verdictSemantics.PASS: every scenario executed with nonzero real entrance count and the observed outcomes matched the frozen THEN; target-side facts bound to the live registration record
verdictSemantics.UNVERIFIED: a required live channel could not be observed (attachment channel: object-store region unset) — recorded honestly, never converted to PASS
